items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: What a sensitive, beautiful player. He isn’t terribly well-known, is he?

ctx.x: . . . Ted Dunbar. What a sensitive, beautiful player. He isn’t terribly well-known, is he? Or is he?

Ted’s been teaching at Rutgers for a long time. Ted studied with me here. He came [to Indianapolis] to be around Wes [Montgomery] and to study with me from Port Arthur, Texas. He graduated from Texas Southern [University] with a degree in pharmacy.
